transcript:
[QUERENT] semantic proletariat

[COMPOSITION]
The semantic proletariat is a class position in modern digital and AI economies occupied by workers who produce and circulate meaning, but do not own or control the semantic means of production. [1]

Core Definition

• Not a demographic: It is not an income bracket, a job title, an identity group, or a simple synonym for "content creators". [1]
• Class relation: It defines a structural relationship to how meaning is generated, trained, indexed, filtered, ranked, and circulated by external platforms and AI infrastructures. [1]
• Expropriation of meaning: Just as the industrial proletariat relies on factories they do not own, the semantic proletariat relies on digital platforms, algorithms, and large language models (which they do not govern) to produce and express cultural, linguistic, and data value. [1][2]

[SOURCE CARDS]
